text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who's the star of the show?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friends
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who do you stan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friends
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand... What're the trending words of
the day?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on getting into Tracen,
Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All done. I'll upload this to UmaTok...
later. Right now, I wanna dig
into this
burger!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Back to off-camera Jordan again, I see.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. You know my mom hates it
when I eat junk food. And I'm high-key
starving. ...Whoa,
what's with those nails?!
Absolute slay!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? This salon only charges
1,500 yen to first-time visitors. I got a
coupon to give to a friend, so here.
Congrats on getting into
Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you shouldn't have... But I'm glad
you did. Love you, bestie.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Love you too! Don't let Tracen take away
your cute vibes, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
For real though, you're breaking up the
dream team here... You sure
we can't talk
you out of going?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, you know how hard I worked to get into this school. Even the teach said something nice about me for once.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Facts. He was totes shocked. But well, I
get it. You're not exactly,
like, the
brightest bulb in the box.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, how many times did you
accidentally throw out your report card?
Or the sports festival signs? You were
practically writing a new apology every
month.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, it wasn't every month. It was every other month!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
That's still a lot! I'm weak! ...Anyway,
we're
happy for you. You better
eat it at Tracen,
okay? We'll be cheering from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah,
thanks... And I will. I mean it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, this is Tracen, right? They should be able to turn even me into a star.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several months later...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(This is it, Jordan. You've gotta win...
Another loss would be so
cringe. Like, for
real.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Pay attention during the start, and get
into a good position. After
that... Keep
your pacing in mind!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Phew... I've got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In search of a racer to train, I decide to
check out the scrimmages. There, I hear
the other trainers talking about one
particular
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that Tosen Jordan? I heard she
hurt her toenail and
couldn't run. Is she
okay?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She might be recovered, but that doesn't
mean it's not going to happen again. From
what I've heard, she's already reinjured
herself a
few times now.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Still... At least she hasn't given up.
I saw her training yesterday, and
she was giving
it her all... Though the dead time did set
her back a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As their whispered conversation worms its
way into my ears, I turn my
attention to
the track.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The racers have taken their positions...
And they're off!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-why do my legs feel so wobbly? I
need steady movements!
Steady!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't! The hell's going on? Why's my
running so sus?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... No!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The leading racers have rounded the
fourth corner and are headed
into the final stretch!
They're quite a ways from the back
of the pack!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Is Jordan all right? She looks almost...
sluggish. She's really trailing
behind the
other racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's lackluster performance
ironically draws all eyes to her.
She
finishes in last place,
far behind the others.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Did something happen, or did she
just... give up? She seemed
like such a
hard worker yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring the trainers' gossip, I decide to
follow Tosen Jordan.
Something definitely
felt off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That was so! Freakin'! CRIIIINGE!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her running, the frustration
she showed was anything but lackluster.
Even after she runs off, I can't stop
thinking about the strange contradiction I
just witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks after that, I begin to hear
rumors that Tosen Jordan is
avoiding races.
